assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One exact square 3-column by 3-row atlas of nine distinct original picture choices for a first-grade Chinese oral picture check, each cell a self-contained illustration, clear ivory gutters centered at the thirds, quiet background, matte gouache, fine paper grain, clean cut-paper silhouettes, pine and cream with warm apricot. No words, letters, numerals, labels, arrows, watermarks or textbook art. Top row shows the same new child with a short black bowl cut, yellow scarf and teal sweater at the same blue circular park gate, gate is on the left, path to a distinct bare rock is on the right. TOP LEFT: the child is outside the gate on the right of it, body oriented RIGHT away from the gate, visible face toward the rock and right foot stepping right. TOP MIDDLE: the child is outside on the right of the same gate, body oriented LEFT back toward the gate, face looking at gate and left foot stepping left. TOP RIGHT: the child sits quietly on the rock, no movement, gate on the left. Middle row: (4) separate two equally aged smiling young children from different families, red scarf girl hands a blank warm-peach greeting card to a same-age boy in lavender, both faces and both hands visible; (5) same red scarf girl hands a blank warm-peach greeting card to a grey-haired seated grandfather, clearly older than child; (6) same red scarf girl kneels and holds a peach card near a little dog sitting on a mat, no other person. Bottom row: (7) low-angle close view of multiple bamboo stems and their jointed green canes curving diagonally left in an open landscape, visible clean bend and narrow leaves, distinct from a straight vertical line; (8) multiple upright bamboo stems, straight vertical canes and still leaves in calm clear sunlight, no bend; (9) a walnut branch with fluttering orange broad leaves, curved breeze trails, distinct leaf shape and season, no bamboo. All figures completely inside their cells, no printed cards.
